_comment: The bin vocabulary. A bin is a KIND OF MOMENT that recurs across worlds; an event points at one by id. Bins are not fixed in advance - tools/bin-events.py adds to an existing bin when an event is like one already there, and creates a new bin only when nothing fits. This file is the outcome of that, and the thing to edit when you disagree with it.

bins.label: economic catastrophe
bins.definition: A systemic financial failure that destabilizes society and causes widespread hardship.

bins.label: assassination alters history
bins.definition: A successful or failed assassination of a leader shifts the timeline.

bins.label: the war is lost
bins.definition: A major conflict concludes with the defeat of the traditional protagonist-aligned power.

bins.label: power vacuum
bins.definition: The death or incapacity of a leader triggers a struggle for control.

bins.label: emergence of new actors
bins.definition: A new category of individual or group begins operating within society.

bins.label: technological or supernatural ascendance
bins.definition: A breakthrough or event creates a being or tool of immense power.

bins.label: decisive military victory
bins.definition: A conflict is resolved quickly and completely by one side.

bins.label: state curtails freedom
bins.definition: A government passes laws to restrict or outlaw a specific group's activities.

bins.label: mass casualty event
bins.definition: A sudden disaster or attack kills a large number of people.

bins.label: prolonged guerrilla conflict
bins.definition: A war devolves into a long-term, indecisive, and bloody insurgency.

bins.label: diplomatic normalization
bins.definition: Former enemies attempt to reconcile through state visits or treaties.

bins.label: pivotal birth
bins.definition: The arrival of an individual destined to play a central role.

bins.label: founding of a settlement
bins.definition: The establishment of a new colony or major permanent outpost.

bins.label: dawn of exploration
bins.definition: The first mission of a new type into unknown territory.

bins.label: interstate unification
bins.definition: Independent powers sign a charter to form a single federal body.

bins.label: technological catastrophe
bins.definition: The sudden failure of a fundamental technology destabilizes civilization.

bins.label: the truth comes out
bins.definition: A hidden reality or secret organization is revealed or discovered.

bins.label: epilogue of continuity
bins.definition: A jump forward in time showing characters in a stable, surviving world.
